facts: Elizabeth Holmes founded Theranos after discussing her ideas with Stanford chemical engineering professor Channing Robertson in 2003.
Theranos has raised more than $400 million from equity sales, valuing the private company at more than $9 billion as of June 2014.
The company operates a high-complexity laboratory certified by the federal Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS).
Theranos performs blood diagnostic tests using only a few drops of blood obtained via a finger stick into a tiny vial called a nanotainer.
Prices for Theranos tests are set to never exceed half the Medicare reimbursement rate for each procedure.
Theranos collection centers operate at its headquarters in Palo Alto and at 21 Walgreens locations in Palo Alto and Phoenix.
